headline: A sound plan with no blockers and two majors. (1) The webrtc-noise-gain binding always enables the WebRTC high-pass filter, so apm_ns is NS + HPF, not NS alone; switch to pywebrtc-audio's standalone NoiseSuppressor. (2) The DSP-slice mechanism readout uses a control confounded with source: the no-DSP bona slice is 124 of 128 online clips, while NS/AGC/VAD slices are 100 % offline. Some predicted gains (plc ≥ 7 clips, VAD ≥ 6) match or exceed the whole stage-specific deficit, and the falsifier bands sit inside the merge-vs-final noise of the same run. Fix: same-source difference-in-differences with paired flip counts. The rest are minors.

objections.claim: webrtc-noise-gain always enables the APM high-pass filter (only NS and AGC are optional), so the lever is NS + HPF on 30 % of clips. That is two components, contrary to the plan's 'NS alone is one component'. A low-band cut can carry class information (rumble / hum in bona vs clean TTS), and with this backend no control can separate it.
evidence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OHF-Voice/webrtc-noise-gain/master/src/webrtc_noise_gain_cpp.cpp: 'self->audio_config.high_pass_filter.enabled = true;' is set unconditionally; NS / AGC only if > 0
rdloop/B4/debate/proposal_v1.md:189 ('NS alone is one component'), :216 ('prints the < 100 Hz energy change, in case the binding runs the APM high-pass filter')

https://github.com/strands-labs/pywebrtc-audio: standalone NoiseSuppressor(sample_rate, num_channels, level 0-3 = 6/12/18/21 dB); HPF only as an AudioProcessor flag, default off; Python 3.10-3.14 wheels
objections.required_change: Make pywebrtc-audio's standalone NoiseSuppressor the primary backend (NS only). Map levels 0-3 to WNG 1-4 one-to-one, define --aug_apm_ns_levels backend-neutrally, and update the dependency import name at the gate. Make check_apm assert (not print) that the <100 Hz band is not cut beyond the NS gain. If WNG stays the backend, rename the component to 'HPF + NS' and pre-register an HPF-only attribution control.

objections.claim: The slice readout cannot attribute gains to the levers. (a) Heldout NS/AGC/VAD/BW run only on offline sources, so the no-DSP control (n=128) is 124 online + 4 offline; 'afftdn gain > no-DSP gain' and the VAD gain compare offline against online, and a generic offline shift satisfies them. (b) Slices overlap: ns:afftdn has 8 exclusive bona clips, and 42/74 co-occur with bw, 26/74 with plc. (c) Against same-source controls the stage-attributable deficit is about 6 clips for plc (merge and final) and about 7/4 clips for VAD, so the predicted plc ≥ 7/130 and VAD ≥ 6/73 need a non-specific gain. Merge vs final of the same run already differ by 4 discordant clips on afftdn and on VAD, so the falsifier bands (≤ 2 / < 3 clips) are inside within-run noise.
evidence: computed (read-only join of RUN local_eval/{merge_top5,epoch_8}/scores/sim_heldout_v1.txt with data/dev_noisy_sim/heldout_v1/meta.csv, half B bona): offline+dsp 197, offline none 4, online+dsp 66, online none 124; offline with NS n=146 recall 66.4/67.1 vs without NS n=55 76.4/74.5; offline with VAD n=73 63.0/65.8 vs without n=128 72.7/71.1; online plc n=66 65.2/68.2 vs online no-plc n=124 71.8/71.8; offline plc n=64 67.2/65.6 vs no-plc n=137 70.1/70.8; ns:afftdn exclusive n=8; merge->final discordant afftdn 3 fixed/1 broken, vad 3/1, plc 2/1
scripts/build_dev_noisy_sim.py:189 (NS/AGC/VAD/BW only if src == offline), :199 (PLC on all clips)
objections.required_change: b4_dsp_slices.py and the signatures: (1) use same-source controls: apm_ns = offline with NS vs offline without NS (146/55) plus afftdn vs anlmdn; dtx_gate = offline with VAD vs without (73/128); opus_plc = within-src plc vs no-plc, online half primary. Report difference-in-differences in clips. (2) Print paired fixed/broken counts with an exact sign/McNemar p, and the B2f merge-vs-final discordance as the noise reference. (3) Restate thresholds as a fraction of the stage-attributable deficit, and falsifiers as DiD ≤ 0 or within that noise. (4) Report exclusive-stage counts. (5) dtx_gate: stratify saturated FA by the eval clip's non-speech fraction and predict the drop concentrates in the high tertile.

objections.claim: G2 is listed as a target, but matched has no loss and the lever's matched prediction is 'unchanged'; nothing predicts a G2 gain.
objections.required_change: Drop G2 from gap_ids, or state a matched-side prediction with a falsifier.

objections.claim: The loss range is justified by the heldout realised mean (0.085 = heldout 0.085), an eval-set statistic. The GE loss pattern is the reserved sim_ops.packet_loss family with overlapping parameters (burst 1.4-3.3 vs U(1,4)). The range itself came from ADD-C via the scout, so the problem is the stated rationale and the G6 labelling.
objections.required_change: Justify the range from ADD-C (PLR 0/1/5/10/20 %) or RTC measurements, not from heldout meta.csv. Label heldout plc as 'loss-pattern family seen (GE); codec + concealment unseen'.

objections.claim: NS's realised effect is likely class-asymmetric (a bona noise floor is removed; TTS has little to remove). The plan measures class asymmetry for DTX only, and the per-class telemetry counts application, not effect.
objections.required_change: Add checks apm_balance: realised dB removed per class on 200+200 training clips (with and without a noise stage), and name a guard.

objections.claim: 'B2f never trained on any suppressor' is overstated: RTCFake train includes online clips sent through Zoom and QQ (their NS/VAD/codec), though on clean input.
evidence: https://arxiv.org/html/2604.23742v1 (fetched): training platforms P01-P02 = Zoom, QQ; online training clips 6,890 real / 30,235 fake
objections.required_change: Rephrase as 'never noisy speech through a suppressor and no simulated DSP'.

objections.claim: Cost estimates use wall-clock times under load. The container has a 16-CPU cgroup quota for 64 loader workers, about ≤ 0.39 CPU-s per clip at B2f's ~41 clips/s if loader-bound. Whether B2f is loader-bound is unknown, so the 1.02-1.05 factors are unverified, and the 758-clip smoke rate is dominated by start-up.
objections.required_change: checks timing reports CPU-seconds per clip (process_time) for the full B2f path and for each new stage, plus a projected epoch factor assuming a saturated loader.

objections.claim: The §5 combined arm (all signature-positive levers on) is a multi-factor change against B2f, against the wave's one-factor rule.
objections.required_change: Frame it as a recommendation to the owner / exp-designer (coupled group or a separate wave), not a pre-registered arm.

objections.claim: The in-process libopus decode at 16 kHz differs from B2f's ffmpeg native decode at 48 kHz plus resample (aligned SNR 17-18 dB): a second component, controlled only if the arm is positive. Per-clip libopus states in persistent workers must be freed.
objections.required_change: Optional: decode at 48 kHz and resample_poly to 16 kHz to mimic the ffmpeg path; keep the zero-loss check; destroy the encoder/decoder in finally.

per_lever.note: Right hook and the strongest evidence (TFCL Mix), with a large offline-NS deficit (~15 clips vs offline bona without NS). Switch to an NS-only backend (pywebrtc-audio NoiseSuppressor) (O1.1) and add apm_balance (O1.5).

Careful design (class telemetry, dtx_balance, reserve-safe name, spoof-miss guard). Only the readout needs same-source controls, paired counts, a non-speech stratification of the saturated core, and thresholds above within-run noise (O1.2).

Dependency-free, with well-tested draw-order equivalence and a bit-identical fallback, plus a pre-registered control. Fix the readout (O1.2), the G2 claim (O1.3) and the loss-range rationale (O1.4). Decoder parity (O1.9) is optional.

alternatives.idea: Use pywebrtc-audio's standalone NoiseSuppressor (NS only, levels 0-3 = 6/12/18/21 dB, py3.10-3.14 wheels) instead of webrtc-noise-gain, whose APM wrapper hard-wires the high-pass filter on.
alternatives.why: Keeps apm_ns a single component at no extra cost (O1.1).

alternatives.idea: Stratify the saturated noisy-bona FA by the eval clip's non-speech fraction (webrtcvad on the local sim audio, read-only analysis) and predict that the dtx_gate drop concentrates in the high non-speech tertile.
alternatives.why: Gives a mechanism-specific readout for G3; the raw 136/133 count moves with any generic bona gain (O1.2).

alternatives.idea: Decode the in-process libopus path at 48 kHz and resample to 16 kHz, mirroring ffmpeg's native-decoder + resample path.
alternatives.why: Shrinks the 'in-process vs ffmpeg decoder' second component before any control arm is needed (O1.9).

citation_checks.note: API as claimed (AudioProcessor(auto_gain_dbfs 0-31, ns level 0-4), Process10ms -> .audio/.is_speech, 16 kHz int16). CHANGELOG 1.3.0: ABI3 wheels, so cp312 is covered.
Contradicts 'NS alone': high_pass_filter.enabled = true is unconditional (O1.1). NS levels 1-3 -> kLow/kModerate/kHigh, else kVeryHigh.
